Hello everyone, I am everyone, thank you for your support!
《Multiverse loot Hunter》 will be released on January 3, 2025 at 10:00 am Beijing time [/color]!
Here, I will release the version of the game, the price, and the various issues you are concerned about the preview and explanation:

[color=yellow] Version content [/color]
1.[color=yellow] plane [/color] : The first batch of eight different planes will be on the line, including: The Three Kingdoms of the Eastern Han Dynasty, Wuxia Jianghu, touching gold and raiding tombs, the Cross of the East, Liaozhai Zhiyi, Japan Warring States, World War II, mortal cultivation. Each bit should have about 10 characters, totaling no less than 80+ characters. Various forces, cities, skills, equipment, recipes, and life stones are also distributed on each side. Combat classes open to 2nd shift.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893696/707eb81302330f61dae44bd68d32cf2c28375c2b.png

2.[color=yellow] City [/color] : Unlock the forging center, synthesis institute, museum, headquarters, research institute, Construction Bureau, real estate agency, municipal center, training ground, antique shop, etc. Each building has its own operating or growing system. For example, you can climb the science and technology tree in the research institute, you can build buildings in the construction bureau to develop the city, buy land in the real estate agency to collect rent, collect tickets for the display of treasures in the museum, in the forging bureau, the synthesis of enhanced equipment, the synthesis of life stones, and so on, to improve the combat power.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893696/898b98daff4680be215644c648e8c877e43d12d5.png

3.[color=yellow] Challenge [/color] : A new secret world system will be opened. At the same time, the phantom tower system and the reincarnation system are also undergoing final debugging and will be online two days later.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893696/3cc82bb1c06e232c26205fd422e404b9877db18c.png

[color=yellow] 2. Previous problems [/color]
For the obvious problems reported in the preliminary test, the following modifications have been made:
1. The task operation is complicated and the power contribution reputation is difficult: the display of the mission panel has been optimized, and the "introduction letter" of the power mission refresh item has been added in the game, which can be dropped by hanging up or purchased by hanging up currency. You only need to refresh the force task with the obtained and purchased letter of introduction after each hang up, and spawn a large number of tasks that can be quickly completed to hand over equipment and hand over materials, and you can quickly get a large number of reputation contributions. This way not only solves the pain of the hang-up party does not want to operate, but also preserves the way that the hand liver party wants to finish the task as soon as possible. But, you can't say, you want to hang up faster than the liver person... Liver's gotta be the fastest. It's the same everywhere, right
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893696/af48557883d116a7e4ff620d207e6bb5364c9ee5.png

2. The main character is fixed and there are no women to choose from: the creation Angle system has been added. At present, you can freely choose male and female images, and freely name, while creating a role, the initial has 20 stars, can set initial attributes, abilities, talents. Here is a foist, the late game will update the external archive that is the multi-bureau system, the subsequent week will inherit the star soul that will be obtained in the previous round, the hexagonal warrior opening is not a dream.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893696/40046a78b64036c4f53b5045d6bd6ca0ca554209.png

3. The Life Stone is too confusing: The Life stone system was reworked. There are now only 9 levels of life stones. And move to the Secret world challenge to gain. You will have an easier time getting better life stones. At the same time, increased the life stone synthesis function, immediately fall out, four in one way, can also synthesize the life stone that can fall in the high-level secret environment.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893696/7f59463e106b0fa8630c1060d76327787c66d52d.png

4. Need to switch back to the city in battle: To be honest, I understand your need point. But I'm facing some low-level procedural difficulties here. But still, I face your needs, and if I can't, I find another way. Optimized the logic of automatic disposal of fallen equipment, now the highest quality equipment within the disposal range will automatically enter the antique shop, technology, construction to a certain period, under the premise of six queues, it takes a long time to return to the city setting demand. The museum does not need replenishment operations, forging, synthesis bureau can put a large number of materials in one time. At this point, in addition to the early stage, you need to manually go back and forth, the need for frequent return to the city in the late stage of the test is basically solved.

There are a lot of details that I won't go into here. Of course, there are many unsolved, not found, I wait for you to communicate with me at any time!

[color=yellow] Update plan [/color]
《Multiverse loot Hunter》 has a better framework, and the content currently completed is enough for everyone to feel comfortable for a long time.
But I also have bigger ambitions and bigger plans. But to be honest, part of it has to be done, and the other part has to be sold and made rich.
Here I [color=yellow] only preview must, will definitely finish the part [/color], familiar old players know that I draw the cake, may change the taste, but will never become smaller.
The following content will be completed within 6 months:
1.[color=yellow] More planes [/color] : A total of 13 planes are planned for the official version. The remaining five planes of the game will be completed as soon as possible.
2.[color=yellow] more cultivation [/color] : deputy system: the fetters between the protagonists and help grow; Spirit animal system: catch pet, cultivate, hit books; Medal system: character limit growth and challenge;
3.[color=yellow] More buildings [/color] : zoo, Enlightenment field, war department, academy will be launched one after another. Each building is a separate gameplay system.
4.[color=yellow] More challenges [/color] : there are plans for the beast tide system, the world boss system, the hunting system, and the Great Secret environment system
5.[color=yellow] More items and skills [/color] : constantly add stronger equipment, skills, cheats. Including the planned growth weapons, exclusive weapons.

You may think that I have blown a big bull and drawn a big cake, but here I really only say that I have thought about it, and indeed will do it.
Based on the good extensibility of the framework, we can add many facets, characters, gameplay, and systems.
If you have better suggestions and ideas, you can contact me at any time.

US $11.99. Initial discount of 10%

The demo version of the official version of the 《Multiverse loot Hunter demo》 will be disabled before January 3.

Finally, let me say something from my heart, 《Multiverse loot Hunter》 is not a "professional game".
Small vast just stand on their own is also the player's point of view, to do a fun, and let people on the top and easy game.
There is no compelling main story, no interlocking system design, no beautiful art animation, and even no sophisticated computing resources, let alone numerical balance.
And determined to pass on the same, I from the beginning, just want to do a relaxed, top game, so that you can feel the happiness of no brain at leisure. When you are busy, you can also easily hang up the game, comfortably, without loss and burden.

notes.title: English version updated!
notes.notes:
With the help of enthusiastic players, the English version of the game is online!

ver1.1.3.0
[color=yellow]How to access the English version？[/color]
Dear English players around the world: Due to lack of experience, skills, and language in developing the game for the first time, 
I am unable to implement the official built-in version of the translation. But also hope you can also play this game in English.
So I uploaded the English translation mod made by enthusiastic players to the beta version, you need:

[color=yellow]1. Right-click the games list on the left of steam and select the game.
2. Select the Properties button.
3. Select the Betas TAB and select "english" beta.
4.Wait for the game update to complete, enter the game.[/color]

[color=lightblue]Thanks to the following kind friends who translated this version!
Mim
Tichat002
an anonymous person
They established a game community in discord: https://discord.gg/6x8dxeRTVE[/color]

There may be some problems with text display after using this mod.
Thanks to all players for your understanding!
